ui.hero.title: One platform for every animal in your care
ui.hero.sub: Records, daily operations and teamwork across all your sites. Find any task in Antz, with the real screens.
ui.modules.lede: Tap any card to open its guide, with every feature and its screens.
ui.cta.text: Every module has its features and real screens in this guide. Pick up where you left off, or ask us and we will help.
ui.day.title: What your first day on Antz looks like
ui.day.4.desc: Create roles that match your organisation and switch permissions on module by module, so each person sees what their work needs.
ui.faq.q2: Does it work on phones and computers?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile app covers work on the ground, such as notes, treatments, transfers and egg records. The web app covers desk work, such as the hospital system, nursery set-up, reports and pharmacy stock. Updates appear in real time on phone, tablet and desktop.
ui.faq.q3: Can we control who sees what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is role-based. You create the roles your organisation uses, for example Zoologist, and turn permissions on module by module.
ui.faq.q4: We run more than one site. Does that work?
ui.faq.a4: Antz keeps data from every site and department in one place. Housing is organised by site, section and enclosure, and moves between sites go through approval and a security check-out.
ui.faq.a5: Start with the Getting Started guide, then open the modules your role uses. If something is unclear, write to hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Necropsy
m.necropsy.intro: The Necropsy Module documents post-mortem examinations with detailed observations, organ-specific findings, and medical conclusions. It supports accurate cause-of-death analysis, standardises reporting, ensures timely carcass handling, and meets legal, audit and veterinary standards.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search & filters
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal/species; filter by site, date, priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Monitor transfer stages, Incoming, Pending, Draft, and Completed.
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card & request info
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, location, cause, requester, priority.
m.deworming.title: Deworming
m.deworming.intro: The Deworming Module supports systematic recording and monitoring of parasite-control treatments, ensuring timely administration, proper documentation, and clear tracking of every deworming activity for each animal.
m.deworming.f1.title: Status-based views
m.deworming.f1.desc: Deworming organised into Upcoming, Pending, Skipped, and Completed for easy monitoring.
m.deworming.f2.title: Deworming management
m.deworming.f2.desc: Schedule a course or directly record administered medicine with defined dates and details.
m.deworming.f3.title: Administration recording
m.deworming.f3.desc: Captures dosage, batch number, delivery route, notes, and optional follow-up.
m.housing.title: Housing
m.housing.intro: The Housing module organises animal habitats across your sites, sections and enclosures, so every animal has a known place and every change is tracked. Access at each level is permission-based.
m.housing.f1.title: Site administration
m.housing.f1.desc: Add or edit sites with role-based permissions for secure, structured access.
m.housing.f2.title: Section administration
m.housing.f2.desc: Add or edit sections within the zoo, with permission-based controls for safe administration.
m.housing.f3.title: Enclosure administration
m.housing.f3.desc: Add or edit enclosures and monitor each for efficient animal and data oversight.
m.fetal-death.title: Fetal Death
m.fetal-death.intro: The Fetal Death Module records and manages fetal-death incidents within enclosures, capturing cause, timing, and related animal details. It supports veterinary care, reproductive-health monitoring, trend analysis and improved population management.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Add fetal-death record
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Log new incidents, cause, timing, parentage, animal info.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search & filters
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword; filter by site, date,  still Birth or Abortion, species or gender.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: View deceased records
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: Full detail, days since death, cause, ID, enclosure, site, sex.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg Management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The Egg Module tracks the full lifecycle of eggs, from laying to hatching or nursery transfer, ensuring accurate records, real-time updates, and complete traceability for better coordination and accountability across nest, nursery and hatchery teams.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg dashboard
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Live counts, in nests, moved to nursery, marked for discard.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Egg entry (nest / nursery)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs with parents, condition, dates, species, notes, attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Lifecycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight, and the full Egg Journey Timeline.
m.administer-medicine.title: Administer Medicine
m.administer-medicine.intro: The Administer Module complements Medical Records by translating prescriptions into actionable treatment workflows, enabling real-time care delivery for individual or batch animals, in the field or in the hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a direct administer record for a chosen date without writing a full medical record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search & filters
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Find records fast and narrow the list by date, entity, Species, Control Substance.
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: View treatments by date across four tabs, Pending, Administered, Skipped, Stopped.
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The Vaccination Module manages the complete vaccination lifecycle for animals from scheduling and direct administration to tracking upcoming, pending, skipped, and completed vaccinations. It ensures timely treatment, accurate dosage recording, and full traceability for disease prevention and clinical compliance.
m.vaccination.f1.title: Status-based views
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Vaccinations organised into Upcoming, Pending, Skipped, and Completed for easy monitoring.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Schedule a vaccination or directly record an administered vaccine with defined dates and medicine details.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Administration recording
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Captures dosage, batch number, delivery route, notes, and optional follow-up.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: Enables fast, accurate, and traceable dispensing of medical products directly to authorised doctors, ensuring timely fulfilment and automatic inventory updates from prescription through to the shelf, with batch-level visibility and expiry tracking throughout.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Dashboard
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: Real-time insights on stock issues, shipments, purchases, requests, usage, expiries and fast-moving products, with visual trends for quick action.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search & filters
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Quickly find records by Request ID, doctor name, or pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Masters(racks & shelves)
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Organise storage by rack/shelf counts for quick access and updates, with customisable data (packaging, UOM, salts, drivers, manufacturers).
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Stock report management
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Batch-wise stock with value and expiry; flag low/expired items; monitor upcoming expiries; manage escrow with dispute resolution.
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Product & inventory management
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create products, track inventory and expiry, log purchases/dispatches, maintain a unified ledger, handle substitutes/variants.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Dispense management
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Doctors can prescribe and dispense, or collect medicines directly from the pharmacy, all logged.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Shipment management
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track incoming and outgoing medicine shipments and fulfil them in-app.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Stock adjustment & reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record stock changes (missing, broken, expired); keep audit history; manage supplier returns; download consumption, return, purchase and dispensing reports for finance and demand.
m.getting-started.title: Getting Started
m.getting-started.intro: The Getting Started guide introduces the purpose of the app and walks new users through the essential steps to set up their profile, explore key features, and navigate the platform effectively.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access & Workspaces
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Log in securely and access your designated work environment.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation & Interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Use the home feed for updates, quick navigation shortcuts, and the bottom panel for core tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Pending Necropsy / Administration / Allocation
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals awaiting necropsy, administrative documentation, and subsequent allocation or disposal procedures before final closure of records.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Master Setup & Modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Configure master data, and explore modules like Medical Records, Housing, Egg, Diet and Animal Management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personalisation
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage notes, update your profile, and adjust language preferences.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Understand access levels required for secure operations.
